rationale.conceptual: The method combines established hybrid DFT with projection-operator diabatization (POD) for charge transfer analysis; it requires careful implementation of surface models, energy decomposition, and POD matrix elements, but is not a novel algorithm.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves building 7 interface variants, relaxing isolated components and full interfaces, running electronic structure calculations, decomposing binding energies, and applying POD analysis to compute injection times; this multi-stage workflow with fragile post-processing tools is complex to orchestrate.
